name: pitch-unfairly
description: Builds on-brand presentation decks as interactive websites, with PDF export and desktop, phone, and PDF checks, and publishes them to unlisted links.

interface.longDescription:
Pitch Unfairly makes presentation decks as real websites, built in your brand, and hands them back as a link and a PDF.

Making a deck doesn't have to be work. Tell Pitch Unfairly what the deck is for the way you'd tell a friend, or dump your notes on it, and it writes the story slide by slide and designs every slide for its one job. No text boxes to drag and no templates to fill in: you say what you want changed, and it changes it.

Because every deck is a website, slides can do more than sit there: sliders people drag, calculators they poke at, tabs, live charts, little moments that move. Every deck has a phone layout, keyboard controls, present mode, and speaker notes. Before a deck comes back to you, every slide is checked on a desktop screen, two phone sizes, and a 16:9 PDF page, then goes through a design review.

Paste your website, get your brand. It measures your fonts, colors, logo, and style, shows you a brand board to approve before it designs a single slide, and saves it, so your next deck starts on brand. With an Unfairly account it also keeps notes on your company and your earlier decks, so each new deck starts with more context.

One link, updated in place. Change a number and the same link shows the new version. Anyone on your team can pick up a deck and update it at that link. Decks publish to unlisted pitchunfairly.com links that aren't indexed, carry a small "Made with Unfairly" badge, and go offline whenever you say. No account? You get the finished deck as a folder you can host anywhere.

The fine print: in Codex and ChatGPT Work it builds on your computer and sets up the first time using the Node.js and Chrome on your machine; if either is missing, it offers to add a private copy to a folder in your home directory and does so only if you agree. In a regular ChatGPT chat it builds the same deck on Unfairly's side, so nothing installs. It doesn't edit PowerPoint or Google Slides files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my notes into a 10-slide seed pitch deck I can send as a link.
